coordinateConvention: PDF page points, x right and y down, before any floor registration. Raster review at 1800 x 1391 pixels; long wall endpoints cross-checked against pdftocairo SVG paths.
revision: 04/11/18 printed on plans; PDF metadata creation 2018-11-07
method: Manually reviewed room identities and long wall segments in the original vector PDF and rendered page crops. Room polygons follow the principal interior wall lines; door swings, door recesses, thin walls and small columns are simplified. Exterior outlines are simplified traces, not surveyed boundaries. Other room interiors are not traced.
registrationMethod: Uniform scale and translation fit to three corresponding building/core corners. No rotation or campus georeference is claimed. North is page-up as printed. The residual is an internal drawing alignment check, not survey accuracy.
anchorNames: northeast wing exterior apex beside stair core
limitations: Historical emergency diagrams may predate room alterations. The PDF has no scale bar or measured wall dimensions.
Room shapes simplify small door recesses and wall thickness. Their principal boundaries are supported by the source drawing; shape confidence is approximate.
The basement has a different footprint from the upper floors and a separately shown northwest stair core. Its main floor outline is retained separately.
Three common exterior/core anchors support approximate floor alignment. Vertical spacing is illustrative. The supplement intentionally omits campus georeferencing and uses relative units.
Only the nine scheduled classrooms are traced; offices and other interior spaces remain unmodeled. Courtyard voids are retained on the upper floors.
